answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 9214 Country: India Title: As salam u alai kum.what is the ruling for the animal those are castrated. is it permissible to sacrifice them for Eid ,since it seem to be a defect for me? jazakaallah. Question: As salam u alai kum.what is the ruling for the animal those are castrated. is it permissible to sacrifice them for Eid ,since it seem to be a defect for me? jazakaallah. Answer ID: 9214 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1204/1204=M/1429) It is lawful to slaughter castrated animal, this is not a defect in animals; rather it is good for them; since the meat of such animals is more delicious. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
